title: Signed change of variables ∫_A h dH^k = ∫_{Ω∩Φ⁻¹(A)} h(Φ)·JΦ dL^k through an injective Lipschitz–antilipschitz chart (step 6b(β))
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let Ω ⊆ ℝ^k be open, and let Φ : ℝ^k → ℝ^P be Lipschitz on Ω and c-antilipschitz on Ω for some c > 0 (c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω). Let A ⊆ Φ(Ω) be H^k-null-measurable (H^k = μHE[k] on ℝ^P), and let h : ℝ^P → ℝ be H^k-integrable on A. Put D := Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(A) and JΦ(w) := √det(⟨DΦ(w)e_i, DΦ(w)e_j⟩)_{i,j}, where DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Then w ↦ h(Φ(w))·JΦ(w) is L^k-integrable on D (L^k = volume), and ∫_A h dH^k = ∫_D h(Φ(w))·JΦ(w) dL^k(w).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl k → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (h : Eucl P → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn h A (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn (fun w => h (Φ w) * Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det) (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) ∧ ∫ x in A, h x ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A, h (Φ w) * Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))
